text:
CapCut Video Studio just made every creator a director.

Introducing Director Mode.

An advanced AI workflow for long form video, drama series, and films. Backed by Seedance 2.0 and GPT Image 2, the whole production pipeline is now in one place:

→ Feed the agent an idea and shape it into a full script together
→ Lock in your story and start visualizing characters, props, and scenes
→ Build shot sequences with continuity that holds across the entire project
→ Direct the final assembly and let the agent execute your vision
→ Refine any frame at any stage, as many times as needed
No crew. No studio. No barrier between your idea and the final product.
Available on CapCut Web globally. US soon.
Begin here: https://t.co/G218fOc6lF
#capcutai @capcutapp
content:
Use CapCut Director Mode (Seedance 2.0 + GPT Image 2) to co-write a full script by feeding the agent an initial idea and iterating together  
After locking the story, generate/visualize characters, props, and scenes before building shots  
Build shot sequences in Director Mode to maintain continuity across the entire project  
Direct the final assembly by specifying your vision and letting the agent execute the edit  
Refine any frame at any stage of the pipeline and iterate as many times as needed

translations.es:
Usa el Modo Director de CapCut (Seedance 2.0 + GPT Image 2) para coescribir un guion completo alimentando al agente con una idea inicial e iterando juntos  
Después de fijar la historia, genera/visualiza personajes, accesorios y escenas antes de construir las tomas  
Construye secuencias de tomas en el Modo Director para mantener la continuidad en todo el proyecto  
Dirige el montaje final especificando tu visión y dejando que el agente ejecute la edición  
Refina cualquier fotograma en cualquier etapa del proceso y itera tantas veces como sea necesario
translations.fr:
Utilisez le Mode Réalisateur de CapCut (Seedance 2.0 + GPT Image 2) pour co-écrire un script complet en fournissant à l'agent une idée initiale et en itérant ensemble  
Après avoir verrouillé l'histoire, générez/visualisez les personnages, accessoires et scènes avant de construire les plans  
Construisez des séquences de plans en Mode Réalisateur pour maintenir la continuité sur l'ensemble du projet  
Dirigez l'assemblage final en spécifiant votre vision et en laissant l'agent exécuter le montage  
Affinez n'importe quel cadre à n'importe quelle étape du processus et itérez autant de fois que nécessaire
translations.ja:
---
CapCutのディレクターモード（Seedance 2.0 + GPT Image 2）を使用して、エージェントに初期のアイデアを提供し、一緒に反復しながら完全なスクリプトを共著する  
ストーリーを確定した後、キャラクター、小道具、シーンを生成/視覚化してからショットを構築する  
ディレクターモードでショットシーケンスを構築し、プロジェクト全体の連続性を維持する  
あなたのビジョンを指定し、エージェントに編集を実行させて最終組み立てを指揮する  
パイプラインの任意の段階でフレームを洗練し、必要に応じて何度でも反復する  
---
translations.ko:
---
CapCut Director Mode(Seedance 2.0 + GPT Image 2)를 사용하여 에이전트에게 초기 아이디어를 제공하고 함께 반복하여 전체 스크립트를 공동 작성하세요  
스토리를 확정한 후, 캐릭터, 소품, 장면을 생성/시각화하여 샷을 구성하기 전에 준비하세요  
Director Mode에서 샷 시퀀스를 구성하여 전체 프로젝트의 연속성을 유지하세요  
최종 조립을 지시하여 당신의 비전을 명확히 하고 에이전트가 편집을 실행하도록 하세요  
파이프라인의 어느 단계에서든 프레임을 세밀하게 조정하고 필요한 만큼 반복하세요  
---
translations.pt-BR:
Use o Modo Diretor do CapCut (Seedance 2.0 + GPT Image 2) para co-escrever um roteiro completo, fornecendo ao agente uma ideia inicial e iterando juntos  
Após definir a história, gere/visualize personagens, adereços e cenas antes de construir as tomadas  
Construa sequências de tomadas no Modo Diretor para manter a continuidade em todo o projeto  
Dirija a montagem final especificando sua visão e deixando o agente executar a edição  
Refine qualquer quadro em qualquer estágio do processo e itere quantas vezes forem necessárias
translations.zh-CN:
使用 CapCut 导演模式（Seedance 2.0 + GPT Image 2）通过提供初始想法并共同迭代来共同编写完整剧本  
在确定故事后，生成/可视化角色、道具和场景，然后构建镜头  
在导演模式中构建镜头序列，以保持整个项目的一致性  
通过指定您的愿景来指导最终组装，并让代理执行编辑  
在流程的任何阶段精炼任何帧，并根据需要进行多次迭代
